##### Project general facts

Binghatti Titania is a contemporary residential tower located in Majan, defined by its bold architectural expression and refined modern design. The building features a distinctive illuminated façade and clean geometric lines, creating a strong visual identity within the surrounding community. The project offers a selection of studios, as well as one- and two-bedroom apartments, all thoughtfully designed with efficient layouts, expansive windows, and an emphasis on natural light, delivering a comfortable and elegant living environment.

Residents benefit from a well-curated range of amenities designed to support both relaxation and an active lifestyle. The development includes an indoor gym, an adults swimming pool, a dedicated kids’ pool, and a sunken seating area for social interaction and leisure. These features are complemented by carefully planned communal spaces, creating a balanced environment that enhances everyday living and fosters a sense of community.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials and enhanced by a smart home system, offering both functionality and contemporary appeal. Apartments feature equipped kitchens, ensuring practicality and convenience for daily use. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors while benefiting from quality finishes and well-designed layouts.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a 1.5 million square meter district in Dubai. It is located at the heart of the large Dubailand community. Majan is a perfect place for those who are looking for a buy-to-invest property. While the community is developing, apartment prices have not yet reached their maximum values. If you want to purchase an off-plan housing unit, you can count on a good discount.

With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road. These roads provide Majan strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises 100 residential complexes, six iconic towers, four hotels and mixed-use units.

The main advantage of Majan is its proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. While the community boasts its excellent location and good infrastructure, rental rates are not as high as in the seashore or central parts of the emirate. Affordable prices attract locals and tourists who want to rent an apartment in a good area at an affordable price.
